translation: 先把骨骼网格转为带 LOD 的静态网格，并由父材质创建材质实例。按各 LOD 的骨骼或顶点模式采样动画，生成 VAT 贴图；把这些贴图、动画索引贴图和解码参数写入对应材质，使静态网格能够还原动画。渲染器绑定网格、Niagara 系统和子类型；单位写入 Visualize.RendererClass、AnimShared.AnimData 及实际烘焙采样率。新单位通过 @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitCreate 创建，再通过 @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitPlanMergeUpdate 和 @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitApplyPlan 写入配置。
name: UMassBattleUnitEditorMCPApi::MCP_EditorApplyCreateVatUnit
source_text: The skeletal mesh is converted into a static mesh with LODs and instances of the parent material. For each LOD, bone or vertex mode samples the animations into VAT textures; these textures, an animation-index texture and decoding parameters are assigned to that LOD's materials so the static mesh can reproduce the animation. The renderer receives the mesh, Niagara system and subtype; the unit receives Visualize.RendererClass, AnimShared.AnimData and the baked animation sample rate. New units are created through @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitCreate, then configuration is written through @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitPlanMergeUpdate and @ref UMassBattleUnitMCPApi::MCP_UnitApplyPlan.
